title: Rebuilds retain pregame context and recover live CFBD credits
items: Before suppressing a college-football refresh, Matchday now reconciles CFBD's persisted balance through the provider's documented zero-call info endpoint; the live account reported 582 calls remaining.
CFBD pacing now permits a bounded preseason schedule/model rebuild while retaining the 25-call hard reserve, adaptive cadence, and six-hour status-probe cooldown.
Production workflow dispatches can explicitly force one full competition rebuild without bypassing any provider quota or data-validation guard.

Pregame injuries, lineups, starters, weather, venue context, and provenance now survive fixture rebuilds in a fixture-bound last-known snapshot; new observations replace the snapshot only when the material context changes.

Soccer injury and lineup checks now receive the shared API-Football allowance before postgame statistics, and the expanded view explains whether personnel is not due, checked-empty, or unavailable because no cleared feed exists.
Prior-season NFL and college-football records are hidden from expanded fixtures while remaining available to the model only as explicitly stale, dampened priors.
The neutral-venue comparison now uses aligned rows, a readable hypothetical label, and a compact mobile layout.
